A combined vaccine composed of diphtheria formol toxoid, tetanus formol toxoid, in- dividually purified antigenic components of Bordetella pertus- sis, hepatitis B surface antigen, and a mineral carrier such as alu- minium hydroxide or hydrated aluminium phosphate. It should be stored at 2° to 8°, not be allowed to freeze, and be protected from light.
